items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Seregioli. And the gioli became the Jolly. G-I-O-L-I. And it was sort of a nickname that they threw at me and then we decided to use it

ctx.x: In one of the books I looked at, they had your last name as “Seregioli”

Seregioli. And the gioli became the Jolly. G-I-O-L-I. And it was sort of a nickname that they threw at me and then we decided to use it, because everybody I would say — “Seregioli” well how to do you spell that? Is it a C is it an S?
And then you’ve got to deal with the “ja” is it — © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
